lines.en: label toukaspecial15p3:
scene black
The next half hour or so goes by without much of a change to anything.
lines.zh: 接下来半个多小时，一切都没什么变化。

lines.en: Touka continues training her virtual combat skills against AI opponents, Tsukasa sits by herself at some table likely thinking about poor people, and Tsubasa downs probably an entire bottle of wine.
lines.zh: Touka 继续跟 AI 对手磨练她的虚拟格斗技巧，Tsukasa 独自坐在某张桌前多半在琢磨穷人，Tsubasa 则灌掉了大概一整瓶红酒。

lines.en: As for me, I repeatedly cycle around the arcade, spending short bursts of time with each one of them until things devolve into what I would call a mild amount of chaos.
lines.zh: 至于我，我在游戏厅里来回打转，跟她们每人各待一小会儿，直到场面演变成我称之为「轻度混乱」的状态。

lines.en: : Mother! Mother! Can I have permission to rail Touka’s teacher?
lines.zh: : 母亲！母亲！我能得到「骑 Touka 的老师」的许可吗？

lines.en: : Of course dear. Just don’t get hurt. That thing looks like it’s meant for big girls and you’re still so young.
lines.zh: : 当然，亲爱的。只是别受伤。那玩意儿看着是给大女孩玩的，你还这么小。

lines.en: : Tsukasa, no! He’s {i}my{/i} teacher and I get to rail him first!
lines.zh: : Tsukasa，不行！他是{i}我的{/i}老师，该我先骑他！

lines.en: : Mother! Tell Tsukasa to not rail Sensei before me!
lines.zh: : 母亲！叫 Tsukasa 别抢在我前面骑 Sensei！

lines.en: : Perhaps I should be the one to rail him if you two are just going to fight over it?
lines.zh: : 既然你们俩要为这个争，那要不我来骑他？

lines.en: : Am I really the only person finding something odd about this conversation?
lines.zh: : 真的只有我一个人觉得这场对话很奇怪吗？

lines.en: As you can see- a mild amount of chaos.
lines.zh: 如你所见——轻度混乱。

lines.en: Anyway, the Tsukiokas take turns railing me and, after they tire themselves out, the time comes for us to leave the arcade.
lines.zh: 总之，月冈一家轮流「骑」我，等她们折腾累了，我们也该离开游戏厅了。

lines.en: scene noonsky
We spent enough time inside that the sun has already begun to set, taking a bit of the pre-summer warmth back behind the clouds as it disappears.
lines.zh: 我们在里面待了足够久，太阳已经开始下山，把那一点初夏的暖意也带回了云后。

lines.en: And, in other news, I wish it also took Tsukasa along with it since she has been doing nothing but annoying me ever since leaving the arcade.
lines.zh: 另外，我真希望它把 Tsukasa 也一起带走——自从出了游戏厅，她就一刻不停地烦我。

lines.en: : Mr. Teacher Man, have you played the same game with my sister that you played with the hot spring peasant girl?
lines.zh: : 老师先生，你跟我姐姐玩过你跟那个「温泉平民女孩」玩过的那个游戏吗？

lines.en: : I certainly hope not~
lines.zh: : 但愿没有～

lines.en: : Hot spring peasant girl? Are you speaking of Io, Tsukasa?
lines.zh: : 温泉平民女孩？你说的是 Io 吗，Tsukasa？

lines.en: : Does Io look like she fell asleep in a tanning bed?
lines.zh: : Io 看着像是在美黑舱里睡着了的样子吗？

lines.en: : Tsukasa! Chika is part Filipino, her skin color has nothing to do with tanning.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa！Chika 有一半菲律宾血统，她的肤色跟美黑没关系。

lines.en: : What sort of game were you playing with Chika at a hot spring? Is it one that I can play as well?
lines.zh: : 你跟 Chika 在温泉玩的是什么游戏？我也能玩吗？

lines.en: : Sure.
: {i}Ahem.{/i}
: I mean no.
lines.zh: : 我是说不能。

lines.en: : Well, that doesn’t seem very fair at all...
lines.zh: : 那也太不公平了……

lines.en: scene black
The four of us continue to walk around what I am now going to refer to as the “Entertainment District” for lack of a better term.
lines.zh: 我们四个继续在「娱乐区」里逛——姑且这么叫它吧，没更好的词了。

lines.en: I think it’s technically part of the urban one given the size and scope of everything but, at the same time, I don’t really think it makes much of a difference.
lines.zh: 从规模和格局看，它严格说算市区的一部分，但与此同时，我觉得这也无关紧要。

lines.en: All I know is that I haven’t blacked out and forced myself on anyone here, so it’s likely not part of the old district.
lines.zh: 我只知道我没在这儿昏过去、也没强迫过任何人——所以它多半不属于老城区。

lines.en: Regardless, we decide to make our way back to the station for some budget commoner food before venturing back to the area of Kumon-mi we’re all more familiar with.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我们决定回车站，在返回我们都更熟悉的公文美那片区域之前，先吃点便宜的平民食物。

lines.en: Here’s hoping that the Tsukiokas have any amount of exposure to Mexican street food- which is, very strangely, the only thing this subway station seems to have.
lines.zh: 但愿月冈家对墨西哥街头小吃有点接触——怪的是，这个地铁站好像只有这个。

lines.en: scene toukataco1
: If I ask you how I am supposed to order, will you assist me? Or will you just make me look like a nuisance again?
lines.zh: : 要是我问你我该怎么点单，你会帮我吗？还是又会让我像个讨人嫌的？

lines.en: : Of course I’ll help you, Touka. I’d do anything for you.
lines.zh: : 我当然会帮你，Touka。我什么都愿意为你做。

lines.en: : You intend to make me look like a nuisance after all, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你终究还是打算让我出丑，对吧？

lines.en: : Why would I ever {i}not{/i} do that?
lines.zh: : 我干嘛{i}不{/i}呢？

lines.en: scene toukataco2
: Hi. How can I help you?
lines.zh: : 你好。要点什么？

lines.en: scene toukataco3
: Oh, good afternoon. My name is Touka Tsukioka of the Tsukioka family, and this man behind me is my [high_school] teacher.
lines.zh: : 哦，下午好。我是月冈家的 Touka Tsukioka，我身后这位男士是我的[高中]老师。

lines.en: : I am the taco man. Behind me is a sink.
lines.zh: : 我是塔可哥。我身后是个水槽。

lines.en: : Say hello, Sensei. You don’t want to be rude to the taco man, do you?
lines.zh: : 打个招呼，Sensei。你可不想对塔可哥失礼吧？

lines.en: Well, this is already going better than I expected.
lines.zh: 得，这开局已经比我预期的顺了。

lines.en: : May I trouble you for a recommendation, taco man? I am not well-versed in the art of Mexican cuisine, so I’m not quite sure what to order.
lines.zh: : 能麻烦你给点推荐吗，塔可哥？我对墨西哥菜这门「艺术」不太懂，不太确定该点什么。

lines.en: : All we have are tacos. I recommend those.
lines.zh: : 我们只有塔可。我推荐塔可。

lines.en: : Really living up to your name, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 还真是对得起你的名字。

lines.en: : I don’t get it.
lines.zh: : 我听不懂。

lines.en: Sometimes, I feel like I’m the only normal person in this city.
lines.zh: 有时候，我真觉得自己是这座城里唯一正常的人。

lines.en: : I suppose I will take the tacos, then! How many would you say a three person family would consume on average?
lines.zh: : 那我就点塔可好了！你觉得一个三口之家平均能吃多少个？

lines.en: : I have no idea, Touka Tsukioka of the Tsukioka family.
lines.zh: : 我不知道，月冈家的 Touka Tsukioka。

lines.en: : There’s no need to worry, taco man. I’m sure Sensei knows the answer to a question as simple as this.
lines.zh: : 不用担心，塔可哥。这么简单的问题，Sensei 肯定知道答案。

lines.en: : One thousand tacos.
lines.zh: : 一千个塔可。

lines.en: : Or not.
lines.zh: : 那倒未必。

lines.en: : How about I just give you a random amount of tacos and you come back if you need more?
lines.zh: : 要不我随便给你们上点塔可，不够再来找我？

lines.en: : Splendid! Thank you very much for your assistance, taco man. Have you ever considered teaching [high_school]? We could use more people like you.
lines.zh: : 太好了！非常感谢你的帮助，塔可哥。你考虑过教[高中]吗？我们很缺你这样的人。

lines.en: : My brother used to work at Kumon-mi High. I heard nice things.
lines.zh: : 我哥哥以前在公文美高中工作。我听过些好话。

lines.en: : Used to? Did he retire?
lines.zh: : 以前？他退休了？

lines.en: : He died after some girl hit him with a dodgeball.
lines.zh: : 他被一个女孩用躲避球砸中后就死了。

lines.en: : No one came to the funeral but me.
lines.zh: : 葬礼上除了我没人来。

lines.en: : Well that’s certainly a part of the plot I didn’t expect to ever show up again.
lines.zh: : 好吧，这绝对是我没想到还会再冒出来的剧情。

lines.en: : Oh my! I’m so very sorry to hear that. I hope the purchasing of your tacos will, in some way, help to numb the pain.
lines.zh: : 哦天！听到这个我太遗憾了。希望买你的塔可，多少能帮你缓解痛苦。

lines.en: : It really will.
lines.zh: : 确实能。

lines.en: : Thank you, Taco Tsukioka of the Tsukioka family.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，月冈家的塔可·月冈。

lines.en: : And thank {i}you{/i}, Touka man!
lines.zh: : 也谢谢{i}你{/i}，Touka·哥！

lines.en: : Wait-
lines.zh: : 等等——

lines.en: scene black
: Nope. We’re done here. No one said anything weird and it’s time to eat.
lines.zh: : 不。我们点完了。刚才谁也没说奇怪的话，该吃了。

lines.en: : But...I could have sworn I just-
lines.zh: : 可是……我刚才发誓我听——

lines.en: : Nope.
lines.zh: : 没有。

lines.en: Touka and I wait patiently as the taco man does what he does best and, before long, we’re carrying several trays worth of tacos over to a nearby picnic table.
lines.zh: 塔可哥做他最拿手的事，Touka 和我耐心等着。没多久，我们就端着好几盘塔可走向附近一张野餐桌。

lines.en: scene toukataco4
: So...{i}these{/i} are tacos.
lines.zh: : 那么……{i}这些{/i}就是塔可。

lines.en: : How exactly are we supposed to eat them?
lines.zh: : 我们到底该怎么吃它们？

lines.en: scene toukataco5
: You start by grabbing them. Then you finish by biting them.
lines.zh: : 先伸手拿起来。再张嘴咬下去。

lines.en: : It’s really just a two step process.
lines.zh: : 真的就两步。

lines.en: : We grab them...with our hands?
lines.zh: : 用手……拿？

lines.en: : I mean...I guess you could use your feet if you’re agile enough?
lines.zh: : 我是说……你要够灵巧的话，用脚也行？

lines.en: : Is there no option for chopsticks? Or perhaps a fork or knife? All of us were taught to never eat with our hands.
lines.zh: : 没有筷子的选项吗？或者刀叉也行？我们从小被教导绝不用手吃东西。

lines.en: : That is very unfortunate because I can’t imagine these being consumable any other way.
lines.zh: : 那可真不幸，因为我想不出这玩意儿还能用别的方式吃。

lines.en: : What’s the yellow thing holding all of the stuff inside called?
lines.zh: : 那个把所有东西兜住的黄色东西叫什么？

lines.en: : I believe that is the...taco bone?
lines.zh: : 我想那是……塔可骨？

lines.en: scene toukataco6
: The taco bone?...
lines.zh: : 塔可骨？……

lines.en: : I-I don’t know! It just appears to be the bone of the taco!
lines.zh: : 我——我不知道！它看着就是塔可的骨头！

lines.en: : Are we supposed to remove the innards? Or is the bone edible?
lines.zh: : 我们要把「内脏」挖出来吗？还是这骨头能吃？

lines.en: : Touka, it’s a shell.
lines.zh: : Touka，那是「壳」。

lines.en: : Then say that before I call it a bone, Sensei! Stop allowing me to appear uncivilized in front of my family.
lines.zh: : 那就别等我说「骨头」才纠正，Sensei！别再让我在家人面前显得没教养。

lines.en: : How come I got more than everybody else? I’m the smallest one here.
lines.zh: : 为什么我比谁都多？我是这儿个子最小的。

lines.en: : Probably because you’re the most special, dear. Now, eat your tacos before they get cold.
lines.zh: : 大概因为你最特别，亲爱的。好了，趁热吃你的塔可。

lines.en: : Unless they...already are cold? I’m not quite sure.
lines.zh: : 除非它们……已经凉了？我不太确定。

lines.en: scene toukataco7
: I understand that you’re all very sheltered and don’t understand how most things in the outside world work, but I really feel like you’re making this harder than it has to be.
lines.zh: : 我理解你们都被保护得很好、不懂外面世界的规矩，可我真觉得你们把这事弄得比本来难。

lines.en: : Mother. You go first. I need to know they are safe.
lines.zh: : 母亲。您先吃。我得确认它们没毒。

lines.en: : No, dear. I’m not expendable the way you are. I have a business to run.
lines.zh: : 不，亲爱的。我不像你那样「可以牺牲」。我还得经营生意。

lines.en: : I’m telling Father you called me expendable.
lines.zh: : 我要告诉父亲您说我「可以牺牲」。

lines.en: : I...I will do it.
lines.zh: : 我……我来。

lines.en: : I will be...
lines.zh: : 我来当……

lines.en: scene toukataco8
: The sacrifice!
lines.zh: : 那个「牺牲品」！

lines.en: : Be careful, dear. Have you washed your hands?
lines.zh: : 小心点，亲爱的。你洗手了吗？

lines.en: : Of course, Mother. I’m no heathen.
lines.zh: : 当然洗了，母亲。我可不是野蛮人。

lines.en: : Mother, if Touka dies from taco poisoning, can I get {i}all{/i} of her bedrooms?
lines.zh: : 母亲，要是 Touka 死于塔可中毒，我能继承她{i}所有{/i}的卧室吗？

lines.en: : We’ll see, Tsukasa. Now, pay close attention to your sister. These could very well be her final moments.
lines.zh: : 再说吧，Tsukasa。现在，仔细看着你姐姐。这很可能就是她人生的最后时刻了。

lines.en: : Here I go...
lines.zh: : 我上了……

lines.en: scene black
Being around rich people is exhausting.
lines.zh: 跟有钱人待在一起真累人。

lines.en: Eventually, the Tsukiokas {i}do{/i} eat their tacos. But, unfortunately for the taco man and his deceased brother, I don’t think they particularly enjoy them.
lines.zh: 最终，月冈一家{i}还是{/i}吃了塔可。但不幸的是，对塔可哥和他去世的哥哥来说，我觉得她们并不怎么爱吃。

lines.en: I guess that’s to be expected, though.
lines.zh: 不过这也意料之中。

lines.en: If you spend your life consuming the best of the best, you’ll be nothing but underwhelmed or let down the moment you try something less...refined.
lines.zh: 你要是一辈子都在享用顶尖中的顶尖，那么一旦尝到不那么……精致的东西，你就只会觉得失望。

lines.en: Which I guess allows me to segue into this thought that I’ve been having ever since Tsukasa mentioned Touka openly admitting she likes me as a teacher.
lines.zh: 这让我顺势想到一件——自从 Tsukasa 提到「Touka 当面承认喜欢我这个老师」起——我就一直在琢磨的事。

lines.en: Why?
lines.zh: 为什么？

lines.en: I don’t work with her schedule. I don’t do what she asks or wants me to do. Hell, I’m not even {i}nice{/i} to her the vast majority of the time.
lines.zh: 我不配合她的日程。她要的、她想让我做的我都不做。见鬼，我绝大多数时候对她甚至都不{i}客气{/i}。

lines.en: So why am I preferred over all of the people who were handpicked for the sole purpose of educating her?
lines.zh: 那为什么，我会比那些「专为教她而精挑细选出来」的人更受她偏爱？

lines.en: A small part of me thinks that it might be because Touka isn’t really what her family and upbringing have turned her into.
lines.zh: 我心里有一小块觉得，也许是因为 Touka 并不是她家族和成长环境把她塑造出来的那个样子。

lines.en: That part of me is wrong, though.
lines.zh: 不过，那一小块是错的。

lines.en: Touka is who she is and doesn’t seem to inherently {i}dislike{/i} that.
lines.zh: Touka 就是她自己，而且她好像也并不打心底{i}讨厌{/i}这一点。

lines.en: But, somehow, having everything she could ever want served to her on a silver platter just...isn’t enough for some strange reason.
lines.zh: 但不知怎么，「一切想要的东西都被盛在银盘里端到她面前」，不知为何偏偏……不够。

lines.en: I’m not sure why.
lines.zh: 我不知道为什么。

lines.en: scene nightsky
But I’m also not sure why she asks me to walk her back to the dorm instead of just taking a cab or limo, and here I am-
lines.zh: 但我也不知道她为什么让我走路送她回宿舍、而不是打车或坐豪车——反正我来了——

lines.en: Fighting off the return of the cold alongside the desire to defile one of the closest things to perfection this horrible world has ever spit out.
lines.zh: 一边抵挡着卷土重来的寒意，一边抗拒着「玷污这个可怕世界吐出的、最接近完美的造物之一」的欲望。

lines.en: I won’t, of course.
lines.zh: 我当然不会那么做。

lines.en: Not unless she wants me to.
lines.zh: 除非她要我那么做。

lines.en: But, you know what? Maybe she {i}does{/i} want me to.
lines.zh: 不过，你知道吗？也许她{i}真{/i}要。

lines.en: Maybe {i}that’s{/i} why she apparently “likes” me so much.
lines.zh: 也许这{i}就是{/i}她显然那么「喜欢」我的原因。

lines.en: It has nothing to do with my skills as a teacher or the way I can make her flustered by simply calling her the wrong name a few times in a row.
lines.zh: 那跟我当老师的本事无关，也跟我能「连叫错她好几次名字就把她弄得脸红心跳」无关。

lines.en: It’s the power I possess- and how she knows that her livelihood outside of the bubble she’s grown up in is entirely within my hands.
lines.zh: 是因为我握有的那种「权力」——以及她清楚，她在自己长大的那个泡泡之外的生计，全捏在我手里。

lines.en: I’m likely the first person she’s ever felt powerless against.
lines.zh: 我很可能是她这辈子第一个让她感到「无力反抗」的人。

lines.en: Maybe that powerlessness excites her.
lines.zh: 也许，正是这种无力感让她兴奋。

lines.en: scene toukataco9
Or maybe that’s just what I’m telling myself to fill the several inches of space between us with something less lonely.
lines.zh: 又或者，这只是我用来填满我们俩之间那几英寸空隙、好让它没那么孤单的自我安慰。

lines.en: : Thank you again for putting up with my family and me today. I’m sure it was awfully stressful having to deal with a group of women so much-
lines.zh: : 再次感谢你今天的包容——包容我和我的家人。应付一群这么……的女人，肯定特别累——

lines.en: : Better than me?
lines.zh: : 比我强？

lines.en: : {i}Different{/i} from you.
lines.zh: : 跟你{i}不一样{/i}。

lines.en: : If we were to grade our respective performances at the arcade, I’m sure you would have emerged as the “best.” Would you not?
lines.zh: : 要是给我们各自在游戏厅的表现打个分，我敢肯定你会是「最佳」。不是吗？

lines.en: : If only who we are as people could be quantified by something as simple as that.
lines.zh: : 要是「我们是怎样的人」也能用这么简单的方式量化就好了。

lines.en: : Yes, if only. Imagine how many hours I could have saved if all of my lessons were replaced by leisurely activities growing up.
lines.zh: : 是啊，要是就好了。想象一下，要是我成长过程中所有的课都换成休闲活动，能省下多少小时。

lines.en: : Do you ever feel like you sort of wasted your childhood, Touka?
lines.zh: : 你有没有过一种感觉，觉得自己多少荒废了童年，Touka？

lines.en: scene toukataco10
: That’s certainly a strange question to ask out of the blue.
lines.zh: : 这问题问得真突兀。

lines.en: : Your mom said something like that earlier. I was wondering if you felt that way as well.
lines.zh: : 你母亲先前说过类似的话。我在想你是不是也这么觉得。

lines.en: scene toukataco11
: Hm.
: No.
: I wouldn’t say any of my childhood was wasted.
lines.zh: : 我不认为我的童年有任何一段是荒废的。

lines.en: : Sure, I do wish there was a little more of {i}me{/i} choosing things rather than just allowing myself to be pushed in the directions my family {i}thought{/i} I wanted to be pushed in.
lines.zh: : 是，我确实希望当年能多一点{i}「我自己做选择」{/i}，而不是任由家人把我推向他们{i}以为{/i}我想去的方向。

lines.en: : But to say that any of that was a waste would be akin to saying that I’m not comfortable with the result of all of those years and all of that hard work.
lines.zh: : 但要说那些年是「荒废」，就等于说我不满意那许多年、那许多努力换来的结果。

lines.en: scene toukataco12
: Do you think I’m a good person, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我是个好人吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : I do.
lines.zh: : 我觉得是。

lines.en: : Annoyingly good, sometimes.
lines.zh: : 有时候，好得都招人烦。

lines.en: : I think I’m a good person as well.
lines.zh: : 我也觉得我是个好人。

lines.en: : That’s why I don’t consider any of my early years wasted.
lines.zh: : 所以我不认为我早年有任何一段是荒废的。

lines.en: : Seeing as those years are over, though, there’s not much purpose in dwelling on them.
lines.zh: : 不过，既然那些年已经过去了，再去纠结它们也没什么意义。

lines.en: : And there’s not much purpose dwelling on the current years either.
lines.zh: : 纠结眼下这几年，也没什么意义。

lines.en: : Only a small portion of my life will be spent in this state, you know.
lines.zh: : 要知道，我的人生只有一小部分会停留在这种状态。

lines.en: : I’ll be an adult for the vast majority of my time on this planet. So why would I not look toward the future instead of getting so hung up on the me of the past or the present?
lines.zh: : 在这颗星球上的绝大部分时间，我都会是个成年人。所以，与其这么纠结过去或现在的我，为什么不展望未来呢？

lines.en: : As long as I can remain a good person, anything I endure will be worth it.
lines.zh: : 只要我能一直做个好人，我承受的一切就都值得。

lines.en: scene toukataco13
: And I assume there will be a fair bit I have to endure, what with you suddenly turning my existence into some form of entertainment for yourself and all.
lines.zh: : 而且我想，我得承受的事还不少——毕竟你突然把我的存在当成了你的某种「娱乐」。

lines.en: : You’ve been spending far too much time with Yasu if you think you can just poke me into changing.
lines.zh: : 你要以为光「戳一戳」我就能让我改变，那你真是跟 Yasu 待太久了。

lines.en: : I’m spending far too much time with Yasu regardless of whether I want you to change or not.
lines.zh: : 不管我想不想让你改变，我跟 Yasu 待的时间都够久了。

lines.en: : You absolutely want me to change.
lines.zh: : 你绝对想让我改变。

lines.en: : A little change would be nice, yes.
lines.zh: : 有一点点改变也好，是的。

lines.en: scene toukataco14
: But I will accept you for who you are now as well. Because I know, deep down in this...{i}suspiciously hard{/i} chest of yours, there is a heart.
lines.zh: : 但此刻的你，我也接受。因为我知道，在你这副……{i}硬得出奇{/i}的胸膛深处，是有一颗心的。

lines.en: : It is not as big as mine, nor is there as much room inside for love, but it exists.
lines.zh: : 它没我的大，里面能装「爱」的空间也没那么多，但它存在。

lines.en: : And {i}I{/i} think you should stop pretending it doesn’t.
lines.zh: : 而{i}我{/i}觉得，你该别再假装它不存在了。

lines.en: : Goodnight, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 晚安，Sensei。

lines.en: : I had a nice time today.
lines.zh: : 我今天过得很愉快。

lines.en: : In fact, it was {i}so{/i} nice that I may even consider leaving my family behind for our next outing.
lines.zh: : 其实{i}愉快{/i}到我下次出游，甚至可以考虑撇下家人了。

lines.en: : At the very least, let me know in advance if they’re going to be there so I can mentally prepare to deal with more than one rich person.
lines.zh: : 至少，她们要是也去的话，提前跟我说一声，好让我有心理准备去应付「不止一个有钱人」。

lines.en: : I’ll see what I can do.
lines.zh: : 我尽量。

lines.en: scene toukataco15
: Goodnight!
lines.zh: : 晚安！

lines.en: : What, you’re not going to invite me up?
lines.zh: : 怎么，你不打算请我上去？

lines.en: : Hahah...
lines.zh: : 哈哈……

lines.en: : Now {i}why{/i} would I do that?
lines.zh: : 我{i}干嘛{/i}要那么做？

lines.en: : {i}Goodnight,{/i} Sensei.
lines.zh: : {i}晚安{/i}，Sensei。

lines.en: : Thank you again for a wonderful day.
lines.zh: : 再次谢谢你给了我美好的一天。

lines.en: scene black
I go home.
lines.zh: 我回家了。
